title: What Scripture Actually Says About Grudges (It's Not Pretending It Didn't Hurt)
caption:
Most guys think forgiving means acting like it didn't happen. So they say "it's fine," bury it, and replay it in the shower for three years.

Scripture does the opposite. Joseph named the wrong to his brothers' faces, then forgave them. Forgiveness isn't pretending, and it isn't trusting him again tomorrow. It's canceling a debt you've been collecting on for too long, because you've been forgiven far more.

Tonight, pray for him by name. Out loud. Then do it again tomorrow.

Save this for the name that came to mind.
